    Simple socles of indecomposable injective right modules #

    A nonzero simple submodule of an indecomposable injective module is an essential submodule: injectivity and the local endomorphism ring turn its inclusion into an injective envelope. Consequently every simple submodule lies in it, so it is the whole socle.
